subject: Prep: traffic slices, enablement sprint and exception lanes for Dec launch
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:15:00Z
Subject: Prep: traffic slices, enablement sprint and exception lanes for Dec launch

Team —

We have the greenlight from Acme to proceed with the Dec 14 limited launch (they confirmed capacity and the first two pilot customers). Before we lock the rollout window I want to align on three quick things so we can close the plan by Friday:

1) Traffic slicing: we need concrete slice definitions (percent by user cohort / region) + rollback thresholds. Can Dylan share a first stab?
2) Enablement sprint: who owns the customer-facing playbook, internal runbooks, and the two training sessions the CS leads requested (20 people total)? Laura, do we have capacity to host training on Dec 10/11?
3) Exception lanes: Acme asked for documented SLA exception handling for the initial week (manual routing, priority ops contact, credit policy). We should define the escalation ladder and who signs off on ad-hoc credits.

Quick asks:
- Dylan: attach traffic slice CSV (rough is fine) and list the gating metric for canary -> staged -> full.
- Marissa: confirm doc owners and whether we can compress the enablement sprint to 2 days.
- Laura: confirm training slots and ops on-call coverage for Dec 14-21.

I put a draft folder in Drive (link below). If we can close owners by EOD Friday I will combine into the launch packet for the Exec review next week.

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior PM, Launch
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none (will accept Dylan's CSV next)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-launch-docs
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-12-01T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Prep: traffic slices, enablement sprint and exception lanes for Dec launch

Thanks Jasmine — I can own the enablement deliverables and coordinate the playbook + CS training. A couple of quick notes:

- Compressed sprint: yes we can compress to 2 days (Dec 9/10) if we reduce the external-facing playbook to the top 6 run scenarios and move deeper detail to an internal runbook.
- Doc owners: I'll own the customer playbook and internal runbook, Laura to coordinate training roster and invites, and Dylan to provide the traffic slice artifact.
- Credits: we should cap ad-hoc credits for pilot customers at a $5k weekly ceiling and route approvals to me + legal for anything higher.

I'll put a draft playbook into the Drive folder and share the edit link by EOD.

Attaching a quick CSV: traffic_slices_v1.csv (columns: slice_name, pct_traffic, cohort_filter, canary_success_threshold). Summary below.

Proposed slices (first pass):
- canary_internal: 0.5% (internal beta accounts) — gate: <1% error rate and median latency < 200ms over 30m
- pilot_customers: 5% (Acme + two pilots) — gate: <2% error rate and 95th latency < 400ms over 1h
- staged_region_us: 20% (US non-pilot) — gate: stable throughput and no crashlooping in 2h window
- open: remainder — only after staged_region_us shows stable QPS and error profile

Notes:
- Rolling back will default to canary snapshot; ops will toggle routing via feature-flag.
- For the first 48h we should have a manual ops channel and a dedicated phone tree. I suggest Laura own on-call coordination.

I'll put the CSV in the Drive folder and ping when uploaded.

Thanks for the quick responses. Confirming the following and adding action owners / timeline:

Action items:
- Marissa to deliver customer playbook draft by Dec 3 COB (owner: marissa.cole)
- Dylan to upload traffic_slices_v1.csv and provide canary gating doc by Dec 3 AM (owner: dylan.brooks)
- Laura to run two 60-min training sessions on Dec 10 and Dec 11 at 10:00 PST (owner: laura.bennett). I will publish the roster and dial-in; see attached roster (enablement_roster_v1.pdf)
- Ops channel & phone tree: I will set up the dedicated #acme-launch channel and circulate the priority phone tree. Ops on-call coverage confirmed for Dec 14-21 (rotation: oncall-A -> oncall-B, backup: oncall-C).
- Credits & escalation: marissa, you will route any credit requests > $5k to Legal (legal@redwood.ai). Approvals <= $5k will be triaged by Marissa + Laura.

Meeting: I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Dec 3 at 13:00 PST to close owners and review the canary gating doc. Please accept the invite when it lands.

- Pilot customers will accept the 5% pilot slice. We ask that you keep us in the loop for any canary rollback decisions and notify our success lead (ops@acme.acme.com) within 5 mins of any decision to rollback.
